topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't believe I let this slide for so long. We've been friends for years, and I trusted him. He spun this elaborate tale about his high-flying job, the meetings, the travel. It was all a facade. I found out today he’s been working at a diner, flipping burgers. How could he do this to me? I mean, is it really that bad to just be honest? I feel like everything we’ve talked about is a lie now. I don’t even know who he is anymore. This is more than a job; this is about trust. I don’t know how we move past this.
